Name: Dynamic NPC Outfit Selector
Author: aneirine
Description:
[size=5][b]Pick what each villager wears, right from the in-game menu.[/b][/size]

Choose an outfit for every NPC per season, festival, weather or location, from the appearance packs you already have installed.

[i]This mod exists because I got tired of manually swapping files between folders to get the look I wanted for a season or a festival. I wanted something dynamic instead, something I could just click through in-game.[/i]

[b]This mod adds no outfits itself.[/b] It's a picker: it lists what your other mods (or your own PNGs) already provide, and lets you choose.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50375/50375-1786193306-1627950116.gif[/img]

[size=4][b]Latest: 1.1.1[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Fixed: outfit checkboxes didn't respond to clicks when the game's [i]Zoom Level[/i] and [i]UI Scale[/i] were set to different values.[/*]
[/list]Your settings carry over from every earlier version.

[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (required: it's where the menu lives).[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/*]
[*]Launch through SMAPI, then open the menu with [b]F9[/b] in game, or from the GMCM cog.[/*]
[/list]Want outfits from other authors' packs? Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] too.

[size=4][b]How to use[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Find the character (there's a search box at the top).[/*]
[*]Pick [b]when[/b] the outfit should show: a season, a festival or [i]Island[/i] (Ginger Island resort). Optionally narrow it with [b]Weather[/b] and [b]Where[/b] (indoors, outdoors, or a place like the Saloon).[/*]
[*]Tick the outfit you want, then press [b]Save[/b]. NPCs already out in the world change right away.[/*]
[/list]The blank first card, [i]"no override"[/i], hands the choice back to the game.

[size=4][b]Where outfits come from[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Content Patcher appearance packs[/b]: most seasonal-outfit mods work this way. Install them normally and their outfits show up on their own.[/*]
[*][b]Your own PNGs[/b]: drop sprites into [font=Courier New]assets/Characters/[/font] and portraits into [font=Courier New]assets/Portraits/[/font], named like [font=Courier New]Haley_Spring.png[/font]. Step-by-step instructions are in [font=Courier New]assets/README.txt[/font] inside the mod.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Known limitations[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Older "file replacer" mods[/b] (Content Patcher [i]Load[/i] or [i]EditImage[/i] on an NPC's texture) don't show up as separate outfits, because the game has no record of them. Workaround: copy the PNG into this mod's [font=Courier New]assets[/font] folder (see the sticky post in Posts).[/*]
[*][b]Festival and beach sheets[/b] often have fewer animation frames. Using one for a normal season can cause invisible or mismatched frames. If something looks off, switch that slot back to "no override".[/*]
[*]Changing an outfit [b]while at a festival[/b] only shows from the next day. Set it the day before.[/*]
[*][b]Where[/b] rules for an exact place (for example the Beach) currently check where [i]you[/i] are, not where the character is. A fix is coming in the next update.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]For advanced users[/b][/size]
How rules combine, which one wins when several apply, and how to edit [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] by hand: see the [url=https://github.com/aneirine/dynamic-npc-outfit-selector#how-the-mod-decides-which-outfit-wins]guide on GitHub[/url].
Found a bug? Use the [b]Bugs[/b] tab and attach your SMAPI log from [url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log[/url].

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
The outfits in the screenshots aren't included. They belong to:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] by Poltergeister[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11389]Seasonal Haley[/url][/*]
[/list]Full credit to their authors.
